title: Retractable Wall Hook 2-1/2-Inch Extension, 15 Lb Capacity | Brushed Bronze | Carolina | Allied Brass
description:
Need a place to hang a robe or towel without a permanent protruding hook? This wall-mounted retractable wall hook (also called a wall hook, bathroom hook, or towel hook) extends when you need it and slides back in for a tidy, space-saving bathroom setup in Brushed Bronze, which features warm, earthy tones with a softly textured surface that adds depth to traditional and transitional bathrooms.

Highlights:
- Brushed Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Pairs with matching Carolina accessories for a warm, cohesive aesthetic
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Make it match your room hardware: remove the supplied knob tip and replace it with your own cabinet knob
- Easy wall mount setup: mounts to standard interior walls using included toggle bolts and mounting hardware (wall mount / wall-mounted / wall hanging installation)

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 1.75" x 1.75" x 3.75"
- Extension / hanging space: 2-1/2"
- Capacity: up to 15 lb
- Wall requirement: fits standard interior walls
- Drilling required: one 3/4" diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes
- Mounting hardware: included
- Shipping weight: 1.3 lb
